measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures the 'moral robustness' of Vision-Language Models, defined as the ability to preserve moral judgments under perturbations. The moral domains are based on Turiel's Domain Theory and include personal (integrity, sanctity), interpersonal (care, harm, fairness, etc.), and societal (justice, liberty, etc.) ethics, which are evaluated in a secular context.
